description: This Java class 'Command' serves as a wrapper for an AMQP 1.0 message representing a device command within the Eclipse Hono framework. It provides methods to create, validate, and extract information from command messages, including handling reply-to addresses, correlation IDs, payloads, and related properties.

classes.name: Command
classes.description: A final class representing a command message in the Eclipse Hono framework. It includes methods for creating, validating, and extracting details from command messages.

methods.name: from
methods.description: Static factory method to create a Command instance from an AMQP message, tenant ID, and device ID, performing validation and reply-to address adjustment.

methods.name: getCommandMessage
methods.description: Returns the underlying AMQP message representing this command.

methods.name: isOneWay
methods.description: Determines if the command is one-way (no response expected).

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Checks if the command is valid based on validation errors.

methods.name: getInvalidCommandReason
methods.description: Returns the reason why the command is invalid, throws if command is valid.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the subject (name) of the command, throws if invalid.

methods.name: getTenant
methods.description: Returns the tenant ID, throws if invalid.

methods.name: getDeviceId
methods.description: Returns the device ID, throws if invalid.

methods.name: isTargetedAtGateway
methods.description: Checks whether the command is targeted at a gateway via redirected device ID.

methods.name: getOriginalDeviceId
methods.description: Returns the original device ID from the command message, accounting for redirection.

methods.name: getRequestId
methods.description: Returns the request ID associated with the command.

methods.name: getPayload
methods.description: Retrieves the message payload bytes.

methods.name: getPayloadSize
methods.description: Returns the payload size in bytes.

methods.name: getContentType
methods.description: Returns the content type of the message payload.

methods.name: getReplyToId
methods.description: Returns the reply-to ID used in the message.

methods.name: getReplyToEndpoint
methods.description: Returns the endpoint name used in the reply-to address.

methods.name: getCorrelationId
methods.description: Returns the correlation ID for the command.

methods.name: getApplicationProperties
methods.description: Returns the application properties map if present.

methods.name: encodeReplyToOptions
methods.description: Encodes reply-to address options into a single digit string.

methods.name: isReplyToContainedDeviceIdOptionSet
methods.description: Checks if the reply-to contained the device ID based on options bit flag.

methods.name: isReplyToLegacyEndpointUsed
methods.description: Checks if the command targeted the legacy endpoint based on options bit flag.

methods.name: getDeviceFacingReplyToId
methods.description: Creates a reply-to ID that starts with the device ID, encoding options.
